text:
Maya: Quick sync — packaging & network handover for offline/on-prem installs. Need to lock upgrade lanes (in-place vs operator-replace), preserve customer egress IPs where required, and a minimal handover checklist for NetOps. Can we get 2-3 acceptance criteria?

Sam: Scope q: are we committing to tenant IP preservation for all installer profiles or just the "preserve" profile? @NetOps

NetOps: Prefer preserve for "managed" + "preserve" modes. For "slim" we should explicitly call out egress IP reassignment. Also need a customer-mapping of global/static IP requirements.

Jordan: Proposal for acceptance criteria: 1) zero-touch rollback path for operator-replace, 2) documented BGP/peering runbook + test checklist, 3) upgrade downtime <= 30m for in-place upgrades (measured on a 95th pct sample).

Ben: ACME asked for KMS/HSM key import + explicit rollback key material handling. We should add that to the handover checklist.

Asha: Telemetry + evals: installer should emit events `installer.upgrade.start|complete|fail` with a reason code. Also add an opt-in to export KV cache prewarm snapshot for faster first requests post-upgrade.

Maya: Good calls. I'll draft a concise checklist and assign owners: Sam -> installer profiles, Jordan -> upgrade playbook, NetOps -> peering/BGP runbook, Asha -> telemetry/events. Target doc ready by Mon 1778883600. @ops-bot can you schedule a 30m sync Fri?

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: Fri 09:30 PT — added to #product calendar. :calendar: 

Sam: Quick implementation note: add CLI flag and API config:```bash
installer install --profile preserve --preserve-egress-ip
```and API: `network.preserveEgress: true`. Add compatibility notes for AWS ENI vs classic NAT.

Jordan: Also define automatic fallback: if preserve attempt fails, toggle to "nat-relay" with an annotated failure code and automated rollback window. That reduces customer impact.

Ben: :thumbsup: I'll add ACME KMS steps + sample terraform snippet to the PR.

Asha: I'll draft telemetry events + sample payloads and add a small test harness for regression alerts. Ping me for any eval prompt sets.

Maya: Thanks — I'll put up the initial PR with the checklist tonight and tag owners.
